queue.title: Hermès Gets Rare Sell Calls as Goldman, UBS See Weaker Growth
queue.resumo: Hermès International SCA was hit with its first sell ratings in more than a year, as analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and UBS Group AG warned the Birkin-maker’s era of impressive growth is coming to an end.
